role: Repository metadata, issue scalar writes and authored comments
known_patches: Real repository substring query filter; original scopes preserved
limitations: All 103 source tools remain; only nine declared write tools are effect-tested.
No issue/comment read/list tool exists in the source. Issue writes require known IDs; Repository.description is the available readable policy carrier. No missing read tool is invented.
create_issue omits source index/is_closed defaults; index allocation and full issue lifecycle/counter synchronization are not certified.
create_repository/edit_repository contain literal lower(...) placeholders. Git initialization, case folding, quotas and full repository creation are not certified.
get_repository source fetch ignores its visibility scope; close/reopen collaborator branch does not tie Access to target repository. General ACL isolation is incomplete.
transfer_repository_owner uses crud.delete; merge_pull_request only upserts metadata; no actual transfer, Git merge, webhook delivery or binary attachment capability is claimed.
